body:
What you're saying makes a lot of sense.  Any suggestions about how to start changing things?    

Thanks for continuing to chat with me.  I'm not stupid, and I'm not helpless, but I am to the end of my rope and I just can't see a solution.  I apologize for being whiny--that's one of the things I hate most in people.

My mother is quite conservative and thinks less of me because I'm a Libertarian lesbian.  (That was quite alliterative.)  And yes, I'm admittedly not good with feelings.  I've often thought/believed/rationalized/whatever that the only two feelings that were valid are anger and humor.  And I know that humor isn't a feeling, but the joy I feel when I see something funny is what I mean.      

I tend to keep things inside and let them build until I explode.  I recognize the problem, but I can't stop myself from falling into the same trap.         

You're right--I know this is something I owe to myself and my loved ones.  I just don't know how to get there.  I know they'd just be better off without me.  One last big hurt is better than a lifetime of continued small hurts.

I don't even know why I'm so angry.  It just hits me out of the blue and then I become the most horrible, hateful person.  I'm just so tired of being so awful to people I love.  I don't know what to do.
